user.title: Connect to an EFAPEL Domus40 Home Server
user.description: The Home Server was discovered automatically on the local network. Enter an existing administrator account.

manual.title: Connect to an EFAPEL Domus40 Home Server
manual.description: Automatic discovery is unavailable. Enter the Home Server's LAN address and an existing administrator account.

confirm.title: Connect to {name}
confirm.description: Enter an existing Domus40 administrator account for {name}.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate EFAPEL Domus40
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current Home Server administrator credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Home Server.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address, IPv6 address, or hostname, optionally followed by a port.
error.invalid_auth: The Home Server rejected these credentials.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Home Server is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered Home Server has no usable address.
abort.no_devices_found: No EFAPEL Domus40 Home Server was discovered on this network.
abort.not_domus40: The discovered UPnP device is not a Domus40 Home Server.

init.title: Identification and protocol diagnostics
init.description: Choose how long devices blink. Unknown-message monitoring temporarily observes all Home Server MQTT topics but stores only redacted topic shapes and protobuf field/wire signatures in diagnostics; raw topics and payloads are never logged.
